facts.fact: ADN's first evaluation report says the government adopted the Plan National du Numerique Horizon 2025 in its programme of actions (Pilier 9, axe 42), the plan having been validated on 5 September 2019.
The plan is named Plan National du Numerique 'Horizon 2025' by ADN, which evaluated it as at 30 September 2023.

ADN's first evaluation report, published December 2023, says that of 69 projects in the plan 33 have started (15 complete, 18 in operationalisation) and that at 66% of the time the plan shows 48% realisation.
